results: Collect picker creates categories, selects multiple memberships and reopens with saved choices; Esc cancels without changing them
Two categories share a single learning item; refresh preserves catalog and memberships
Library item details can change membership without copying the item or changing its learning record
Rename keeps membership; deleting a category preserves its word and exposes it in Unfiled when no live categories remain
Custom entries in another language can be created and filed into a user-defined language category
Duplicate names show a local error; Library adapts to a narrow dark viewport without horizontal overflow
